QUOTE: "Add the define to the module's header, for example `include/mbedtls/aes.h`... Give it exactly one Doxygen description... Regenerate with `make` in `library/` or the CMake build, not by hand... Hand edits to `error.c` will be overwritten on the next build."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says to add the documented define to the public header, regenerate with the generator, and not hand-edit error.c.
